 Introduction 
 Patrick 
Today's conversation is one of my favorites in a long time. My guest is Gabe Leydon, who was the co-founder and CEO of MZ, also known as Machine Zone, the company behind huge games such as Mobile Strike and Game of War. Gabe has spent the last 20 years designing video games and is one of the most original thinkers I have talked to in a long time. In our conversation, we cover why great design can be a bad sign that we've run out of ways to innovate, the most important lessons from human psychology for building games and products, and why products which are busted or breaking but still booming can be great investment opportunities. This conversation rewired my brain on many levels, so I'm excited for you to listen. Take the red pill with us and please enjoy my conversation with Gabe Leydon.
